notes.title: December Release Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]A NOTE FROM THE DIRECTOR[/h1]
[b]Happy Holidays everyone![/b] 

As we head towards the end of 2024, let’s take a quick moment to look back at how CELEROS has grown since the launch of the demo back in July…

[list]
[*]6 NEW LOCATIONS. You can now fly a total of 10 courses beyond the original Aero Bay that debuted at launch
[*]LIMITED TIME EVENTS. All leaderboards now come and go over time and ultimately will gain you rewards for top finishes
[*]FRIEND & REGIONAL LEADERBOARDS. All leaderboards can be filtered by your region, and by just your friends meaning more possibilities for bragging rights
[*]CHASE THE CHAMP. The ability to select ghosts and once you’ve beaten them have new ones automatically load in provides an endless run as you try to become champion yourself
[*]MOAR QUESTZ! With Monthly Quests, the Weekly TXR Challenge, and Special Quests there have never been more ways to earn TXR
[*]PULSE MUSIC JUKEBOX. With motivational Hip-Hop in the menus, and driving EDM mid-flight, music is there to inspire you to new heights
[*]REVAMPED INTERFACE & HUD. The new interface for the game sets it up for a future full of new features, functionality, and fun
[/list]
And it doesn’t stop there as we have an additional 4 new features in this festive build!

So let’s get on and see what Santa has brought you all!

[h1]TRACKS[/h1]
[h2]TRACK 6 PREVIEW[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44946915/3e692307ed0044bc0e49de91b933500fb0c97376.png[/img]
Track 6 brings us around to another Natural setting, where we can take a moment to appreciate the beautiful landscape Earth has to offer - this time choosing snow and ice as the theme to explore.
Featuring an ice cave and narrow ravine, followed by a steep mountain climb and drop back to sea level, this track should give skiing vibes as you navigate thin technical sections followed by epic vistas and flowing corners.
As ever, your feedback is welcomed on this new location and be sure to enjoy the festive decorations we’ve placed throughout!

[h2]TRACK 5 REVERSE[/h2]
Our second City course returns now as a Limited Time Event along with this new reverse route.
We’ve also made minor adjustments to a tricky gate section that was landing a little too far on the side of risk vs reward which ultimately has made the flow better and ensuring you keep more speed around that bit of the route.

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]SPEED FEED[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44946915/b8302b98f6966f1b0908f5ac335f6d15d16cb62a.jpg[/img]
Last month we introduced both Friend and Regional Leaderboards so that all players have a chance of being the best in their local area, or to have bragging rights amongst their friends.
Now we are surfacing that friend-based competition right here on the What’s New screen when you start the game.
At a glance therefore you’ll easily be able to see where you stand since you submitted your time. Have you been knocked off the top spot? If so, who is your new Rival and how many places did that drop you down?
We hope then that the Speed Feed plus the Next Quests widget will be handy guides to what to play when you jump into CELEROS.

[h2]NOTIFICATIONS[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44946915/343c4af83c4236efc566d3f049a07c38382f3fb3.png[/img]
We’ve also overhauled our messaging system to be universal and cover a wide variety of different cases where we want to alert you to a change, an alert, or some reward.
As such, any time something of significance happens in-game a subtle notification will display in the bottom corner of the screen. For this particular build that means…
[list]
[*]Any time the music changes, now showing the artist, song title, and single artwork
[*]Any time you earn TXR (now occurring at the time you completed the quest)
[*]Any time a friend beats your time at a track (which then displays on the Speed Feed above)
[*]And any time you earn Profile Pts (see below)
[/list]

[h2]PILOT LICENSE[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44946915/e9a06469a218bdb42bdf839721d4d5d4056d412f.png[/img]
In the New Year we will be tackling a large new area of the game… the ability for you to alter the performance of your Airspeeder!
For that we need a delivery mechanism that can provide you with the parts you’ll need in order to then craft them.
That delivery mechanism is your Pilot License. Return back to the game, play the various game modes and events, succeed, and be a good member of the community and you’ll progress your License along Loyalty, Play, Success, and Social directions.
Everyone’s License will look unique therefore and will be a visual representation of your personal preference, skill level, and engagement.
For now, each time you do something related in the game it will grow your License. Ultimately these will unlock rewards such as Blueprints for Airspeeder parts and Cosmetics. We’ll have more on that in future months though.
But for now please take a look, see it grow, and report back any issues you find. [i]NB.. we will periodically wipe the License whilst it develops so please don’t get too attached to it just yet! But we hope it gives a sign of things to come.[/i]

[h2]COMMENTARY[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44946915/e93f890b7b0759c47b2f12d1950cba73b3ed00e1.jpg[/img]
What is sports without commentary, right? From legendary motorsports commentators like Murray Walker, to Andrés Cantor’s iconic “GOOOOOOAL!” celebrations in Argentinian football, or the fast-paced duo of Phreak and Kobe in League Of Legends - sports is synonymous with commentary whilst you play.
As a special sneak peek therefore, please check out the first early implementation of Play-by-Play commentary within CELEROS that will (for now) provide onscreen subtitles talking about three main areas of your play…
[olist]
[*]Collisions. Just like in most motorsports - the commentary team will call out the times you mess up, reflect on why it happened, and speculate on your chances of success now
[*]Sector Times. Giving a little inside info on why you were faster within a particular sector and how that may now affect your Potential Lap
[*]Lap Times & Records. Celebrating fastest laps within the session, as well as personal bests beaten, and new World Records being set.
[/olist]
We aim to improve the commentary system incrementally over the course of development as and when new game modes and features are introduced. Plus adding ‘Color’ commentary where a second voice will then fill in any moments of dead air with insight on the track, historical information about rivalries, and anecdotes.
We hope this gives a glimpse of a potential future where everyone feels like they’re on-stage at an esports final with a commentary team celebrating your wins.

[h2]PLAYSTATION 5 DUALSENSE SUPPORT[/h2]
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44946915/202f5087a8d1b6bb8ab440dad231ae329b36f60e.png[/img]
We’re pleased to say that CELEROS now supports the PlayStation 5™ DualSense™ Wireless Controller for both menu navigation and flight control.
Whilst there still may be some limitations or issues here, we hope that you’ll enjoy this new way to play the game.

notes.title: November Release Notes
notes.notes:
[h1]A NOTE FROM THE DIRECTOR[/h1]

Welcome once again to another exciting update to CELEROS!

Rather than rambling on I’ll just get to the point… this is a fairly big one!

On the track front, we have a new city track for you to fly around as well as the reverse route of Track 4 and some minor updates to two previous tracks.

And then we have quite a large interface update - with a new menu system designed for the larger game ahead, an improved HUD putting all the info you need within your eyeline, and finally the ability to filter leaderboards by Global, Region, and Friends meaning even if you can’t be the best in the world you can now show off to your friends or try and be the best locally.

Factor in that we’ve also removed the One Time Code that was previously needed, and made improvements to both quests and music and this new build has plenty of reasons to either jump back in, or strive for higher levels.

And that’s not all! Because there will be one more update coming before the holidays too! And (not to spoil it) but we’re aiming to include first looks at your Pilot License, Commentary, and Speed Feed Notifications in that.

So thank you once again to our community - the OGs, the top pilots, the TXR hunters, the Track Pass owners, and the Hero Node champions - the best is yet to come!

[h1]TRACKS[/h1]
[h2]TRACK 5 PREVIEW[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946915/536595ef70429c2e17f9242e362eed91174ac1b6.jpg[/img]
After visiting a city with Track 1 (Aero Bay), a natural environment with Track 2, a repurposed fossil fuel site with Track 3, and a sanctioned course with Track 4, we now loop back to creating another city track for Track 5.

The aim here is to return back to the free-flowing nature of Aero Bay albeit with the more varied altitude flying of some of the more recent tracks.

Track 5 therefore features a route through city streets, parks, and rural roads and clocks in at a slightly longer lap time of 1 minute 35 seconds (although I’m sure that is going to be annihilated by our super-fast community!).

Please go check it out and give us feedback on how it feels.

[h2]TRACK 4 REVERSE[/h2]
The Reverse Route for Track 4 is now available, with Track 4 now moving out of Preview and into the Limited Time Event game mode.

Please enjoy this alternate route which starts off with a technical section before moving onto a more free-flowing path.

[h2]TRACK 2[/h2]
Grandstands have been added to Track 2 in order to align this track more with others that have areas for spectators to watch from.

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]FRIEND & REGIONAL LEADERBOARDS[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946915/a3fde37f54c006f11c043697f84a4e3c828f01ba.jpg[/img]
On an all-new Ghost Selection screen we’ve added two new features… the ability to filter any leaderboard by just your friends. And also to see the leaderboard for your particular region.

We know there are some super-talented players out there clambering away to be the best in the world and therefore these new systems are built to encourage you to feel like a winner amongst smaller groups - your closest friends or those in the same country or geographic area as you.

We would highly encourage players to add each other as friends within the game which will effectively create a small ladder for you to try and climb each month.

Combine this with Ghost Selection too and we think this will provide great banter moments between friends and encourage further healthy competition.

[h2]HUD[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946915/631ef650403e57ba76a01aaeb01a505bc037da9f.jpg[/img]
And to aid that we’ve also given the top half of the HUD an overhaul.

Your Current Time is now front and center of your eyeline and right above is your Potential Lap which will indicate - based on your passed sectors - what laptime you could achieve if you continued on as you are now.

On the left we now show your Session best along with your Personal Best and your live positioning on the Friend, Regional, and World leaderboards.

When combined with last months update that automatically loads in ghosts ahead of you, you’ll be able to keep a constant eye on your progress climbing up the ranks now.

Finally, when you bring in Ghosts you’ll see their time and name too along with a red vs green color indicator whether you’ve beaten them or not.

[h2]MENU SYSTEM[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946915/6aee1e498f722684e14fcdbec6a8b6a4df702b8d.jpg[/img]
As we start to think about systems outside of LTEs and Quests (namely Crafting and your Profile!) we’ve taken this moment to start progressing our UI towards the hierarchy it should have as a game rather than just a demo.

As such, we have a new menu system that will ultimately show you…
[list]
[*] What’s New in the game and immediate shortcuts to key areas that have changed since you last logged in. One notable one in this build is the ability to see the Quests you are most close to completing right there when you open the game
[*] Online features for healthy social competition
[*] Customization options for your Airspeeder (and ultimately your Pilot and Team)
[*] As well as other tabs hidden for now where you’ll be able to play Solo and engage in Esports and Team-based competition
[/list]
We hope this not only starts to make the game look nicer but also starts to give an idea of where we’re heading and future features.

[h1]NERFS & BUFFS[/h1]
[h2]TRACK 3 REVERSE[/h2]
As we discovered from our last Play With Dev session, some clever players were flying over the initial yellow silo on Track 3 Reverse with little penalty. Ultimately this means that - once you discover this - that route will become the only viable one. Therefore, this goes against our design philosophy which favors risk/reward instead. We have added an additional pipe as a reaction to that - meaning the route over is still possible, however it’s now far more riskier to do.

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Previously, during the initial implementation of them - all Weekly Challenge Quests were ordered. This was so that we could test the system thoroughly. I’m pleased to say that that ran smoothly and therefore we have changed them to be randomized now as originally intended. Additionally, we’ve now added progress meters to each Quest meaning you can now see how close you are to finishing one (eg.. completing a set number of laps) or the ability to compare the requirement with what you’ve actually done (eg.. trying to beat certain lap times)
[*] A minor update - but all laptimes are now recorded to 3 decimal places as per normal motorsports timing
[*] Finally, our PULSE music jukebox system has now switched over to the intended genres of Hip Hop for menus and EDM for mid-flight gameplay. We hope you enjoy this and maybe discover some new artists![/list]

[h1]BEHIND THE SCENES[/h1]
[list]
[*] Both veteran players and newcomers will also notice that they are no longer asked to provide an email address nor a One Time Code.
[/list]

notes.title: CELEROS: OCTOBER RELEASE NOTES
notes.notes:
[h1]A NOTE FROM THE DIRECTOR[/h1]
Welcome to Spooky Season everyone!

Over this last scary September, our frightfully-talented team have been brewing up another hauntingly delightful update to the game.

We’ve got three terrifying tracks to play, two thrilling new ways to earn TXR, plus the ability to bring Ghosts into events with you!

Add in a new music system and settings menu and it makes for a wicked and bone-chilling new update!

[h1]TRACKS[/h1]
[h2]TRACK 2 REVERSE & TRACK 3 REVERSE[/h2]

Last month we added a Reverse route to Aero Bay with the mindset that we wanted this possible at ALL tracks in future.

I’m pleased to say therefore that, indeed, both Track 2 and Track 3 now have reverse routes and you’ll be able to play them as Limited Time Events starting this month!

[h2]UPDATED TRACK 2[/h2]

Track 2 has also received further refinement in order to eliminate some corner-cutting exploits whilst also providing some additional variety to this location.

[h2]UPDATED TRACK 3[/h2]

Additionally we’ve also made a moderate improvement to Track 3 after community feedback that indicated that gate navigation could be improved in some areas. As such we’ve added some new gates that better inform the player on the direction to fly.

[h2]TRACK 4 PREVIEW[/h2]

Another month, another track! This time, the location type is a sanctioned, legitimized race track ideal for flying car racing and therefore representing the kind of course that the Airspeeder series in real life would one day be utilizing.

That means that we now have a City, a Natural Environment, and a Repurposed Fossil Fuel Site in addition to this new Sanctioned Race Track. These are the four types of track we’ll be concentrating on for CELEROS and will soon be putting out a vote on the exact geographical region you’d like some of the existing tracks to reside!

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]WEEKLY CHALLENGE QUESTS[/h2]

In addition to the Monthly (or ‘Seasonal’ as we’re calling them) quests, you’ll now have an all-new way to earn TXR with the Weekly Challenge!

Here, you’ll be presented with 7 quests to complete. As soon as you complete one you’ll earn the associated TXR and a timer will then appear. Once the timer expires, a new quest will then take its place.

Ultimately, you’ll be further rewarded as you progress towards completing 25 quests per week. This functionality will become available in future builds however. But for now, this should provide you with daily ways to earn TXR within CELEROS and ultimately will provide the game with a progression and reward mechanic that will feed into other systems such as Customization!
SPECIAL QUESTS

Special Quests are extremely time-limited quests that only appear for short durations. For example over certain weekends or during popular holidays.

They are aimed at celebrating real-life events whilst also providing incentives for players to congregate during certain times.

The first example Special Quest will be to play CELEROS on Halloween! So please hop into the game this Spooky Season and look out for an event in Discord where you may get to play and interact with the ghouls and goblins that work on the game!

[h2]GHOSTS[/h2]

Every time you enter a Limited Time Event, you’ll now be able to take two Ghosts in with you. These can be picked from anyone on the Leaderboard!

Ever wondered how those aliens get those crazy fast times? Simply take their Ghost into an event with you and use them as both inspiration and a learning tool in order to improve yourself!

Maybe they take a shortcut you never knew about, or a different line through a corner. Or maybe they’re exploiting the track in a way it shouldn’t be so our team can fix it(!)

Either way, from our internal testing so far, we’ve found that beating a Ghost is a transformative experience giving a glimpse at what realtime racing may look like in the future ;-)

[h2]CHASE THE CHAMP[/h2]

But that’s not all! We’ve also added a unique system we’re calling “Chase The Champ” whereby if you BEAT the Ghost you took in with you, it’ll now automatically load the next Ghost ahead of them.

So if you took in the Ghost of your friend Jonny and beat their time, the game will then automatically load in Jenni who was ahead of him.

This means players can now enter Hot Lap and endlessly ‘beat and repeat’, continually climbing up the leaderboard without ever having to leave.

[h2]PULSE[/h2]

We have now added a bespoke music playback system known as PULSE to the game that plays in both the menus and during gameplay. During the development of the game therefore you’ll start to hear new music appearing that aims to compliment and reflect the favorite genres of our core audience. For now those genres are Lo-Fi and Drum & Bass although we aim to update those to Hip-Hop and EDM as time progresses.

To aid this, you’ll now be able to change various volume settings from the new Settings menu.

[h2]SETTINGS[/h2]

Whilst not the most exciting areas of the game to talk about, we know how important customizing the game to your own needs is and therefore we have taken the first step by implementing a new Settings screen that will ultimately allow you to choose between various controller types and graphics settings.

For now, the options remain as Audio, Video, and some Controls settings.

[h1]NERFS & BUFFS[/h1]

We were made aware of an exploit involving Airstream boosts and ground collision that gave Airspeeders an undesired ‘super boost’ of speed. This is not what was intended and therefore this exploit has now been removed

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]

GAME MODE NAMING. In order to better clarify what “Tournament Mode” actually is, it has been renamed “Best Of Three” thereby giving better clarity that the game mode will take the fastest of your three laps as the one to push to a leaderboard.

[h1]BEHIND THE SCENES[/h1]

Our Steam integration is almost complete now so we soon hope to be deploying features around friend-based play starting with Friend Leaderboards and Notifications. More info on this in future release notes!
Similarly, we are looking at streamlining the current SWG App connection process and will have more information on that soon also

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
[list]
[*] The cockpit glass of the Airspeeder has been hidden whilst we fix an issue with how it interacts with the visuals of Track 2. It will return!
[*] Your TXR counter in the top-right of the interface may occasionally not reflect the correct amount. This can be rectified by either waiting for your most recent Weekly Challenge quest to be awarded or from restarting
[/list]

notes.title: CELEROS: SEPTEMBER RELEASE NOTES
notes.notes:
[h2]A NOTE FROM THE DIRECTOR[/h2]

Welcome everyone to the end of Summer (boo!) and another big update for CELEROS.

As mentioned last time, each month we’re aiming to deliver brand-new features to you in the form of new tracks, new quests, and new ways to play.

Whilst last month was the first step on that journey, building upon the success of the Demo and Steam’s NextFest, now we’re starting to confidently stride in a number of key areas in terms of Limited Time Events, social play with Friends, and greater depth to Quests.

So let’s get into it as there’s a lot to cover…


[h2]TRACKS[/h2]

[h3]AERO BAY REVERSE[/h3]

That’s right… you can now fly the reverse route of the beloved Aero Bay track!

When doing so, the starting grid is correctly reversed, as are all guidance chevrons, gates, and airstreams.

Not only does this Reverse route make Aero Bay feel like a totally different track but it also means… a new leaderboard! So go attack it!

And as an additional bonus… this means that all tracks from now on will feature Reverse routes also!

[h3]UPDATED TRACK 2[/h3]

Many thanks for your feedback both in the Discord and via the dedicated Feedback Form. Internally we collated both and then attended to the main topics that became evident. Those being…

[list]
[*] The track felt slower than Aero Bay
[*] Some of the tighter turns were hard
[/list]

In light of this we have made the following changes…

[list]
[*] Track 2 is now 33% longer and wider than previous in order to allow you to reach top speed far more often
[*] Some of the obstacles on the inside corners of hairpins have been removed allowing them to be much more approachable
[*] We’ve removed one corner completely in Sector 2 meaning less time navigating a chicane and more spent accelerating back up to top speed again
[/list]

We’ve also repositioned and added more Airstreams too to keep you at 200mph+ more often.

Finally, we’ve taken a look at the physics and made some improvements there (see Nerfs & Buffs later) to make the Airspeeder feel both faster and more nimble. Spoilers: some leaderboard times are going to be annihilated now on Aero Bay ;)

[h3]TRACK 3[/h3]

Surprise! Whilst we’ve been openly talking about the Reverse route at Aero Bay and attending to Track 2 we wanted to keep this one quiet!

As previously promised (and as was supported in the results from the Feedback Form) we all value track variety highly. And therefore we’re proud to now present this month’s Track Preview - internally known as “Refinery”.

CELEROS as you know is set in an aspirational future where technology and environment are in balance. And therefore our aim is to tell this story through some of the environments we visit in the game.

“Refinery” is one such location seeing the player fly around an abandoned oil refinery - around silos, through pipework, and past factories. All remnants of a bygone era where we mined our precious Earth for fossil fuels.

Now, in our CELEROS future, we repurpose those abandoned sites and instead can reminisce on them as we fly high and clean in our electric speeders.

Once again, we’d love your feedback on this location, what its ultimate name may be, and whereabouts in the world you’d like it to be set.

[h2]NEW[/h2]

[h3]IN-GAME QUEST TRACKING[/h3]

As evidenced with the August build… going forward, each build will contain a new set of GameFi Quests. These will unlock on a weekly basis and now can be tracked in-game via the dedicated Quests screen accessed via the button on the Main Menu.

Phase 1 of this is to provide a way to track these new monthly-delivered Quests in-game. With Phase 2 in a future build then providing bonuses for completing them all, as well as a Weekly Streak concept.

So please enjoy this first iteration for now whilst also seeing a sneak peek at the updated UI for the title that will ultimately fully support controllers including the PlayStation DuelSense (coming in a later build).

[h3]LIMITED TIME EVENTS[/h3]

The goal for players is that whenever you turn up, there’s always something to play either that weekend, all week, over the course of a month, or even spanning an entire season.

At the core of that therefore is the concept of CELEROS being able to update the game live without the need for players to download a new build.

That system is now in place on our new LIMITED TIME EVENTS screen which replaces the prior ‘Tournaments’ screen.

Here, you’ll see any live events available now and how long they’re available for. This is Phase 1 and in Phase 2 you’ll be able to then further see upcoming events as well as the records of the fastest of your Friends and the fastest in your Region.

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]

[olist]
[*] LEADERBOARDS. We’ve added the functionality to be able to paginate through the leaderboards now, meaning you can not only find yourself there but also see who’s directly ahead of you. We’ve additionally added the leaderboard for that particular Limited Time Event right there on the screen just before you enter it too. This is, again, Phase 1 of this feature which ultimately will allow players to select Ghosts to race against in each event.
[*] AUDIO. Crowd noises, boos, cheers, horns, whistles and other bespoke audio has been added for this build meaning the crowd and UI are now far more reactive to the players actions on the track. Additionally, all UI elements before the race now have various bleeps and bloops setting us in good stead for a premium presentation experience going forward.
[/olist]

[h2]NERFS & BUFFS[/h2]

[olist]
[*]PHYSICS. In light of Track 2 being far more technical and elevated than Aero Bay, this gave us the opportunity to revisit the physics of the Airspeeder and make some adjustments so that the flying felt great at all tracks and not just one. The changes made included…
[list]
[*] Removing a penalty that was being applied to the Airspeeder if you oversteered. In practice on both Track 2 and Track 3 this was slowing the Airspeeder down so much it felt like you were at a standstill trying to navigate corners greater than 90° in acuteness. Now Airspeeders should be quicker to get out of tight corners
[*] Increasing the speed of ascent/descent. In reality, Aero Bay is quite flat in terms of elevation compared to the newer tracks and therefore we gave a slight boost to the player’s ability to move both climb and dive
[*] Increasing the Ground Boost distance. Again, the players distance from the ground remains quite low in Aero Bay compared to the sheerer climbs of Track 2 or high sky flying of Track 3. Therefore the height at which Ground Boost still affects you has been increased slightly to accommodate this larger flight ceiling
[*] Top Speed and Acceleration. Currently in game the Airspeeder can be ‘clamped’ in its top speed after hitting an airstream. Ie.. there were occasions when you would have significant Ground Boost plus then the boost from an airstream yet immediately afterwards the speed of the Airspeeder would then dial back to its max speed (273mph). In order to rectify this and make hitting airstreams feel really impactful, the top speed of the Airspeeder has been increased slightly but the Acceleration has been reduced similarly to balance things out.
[/list]
[*]CAMERA. Currently in the game there is a delta between the onscreen sensation of speed and the speedometer in the bottom-right. Put simply… the speedo saying you were flying 200+ mph did not equate onscreen to the rate at which the visuals were flying past you. Minor tweaks have been made therefore to the field of view to address this both in third-person and cockpit view.
[/olist]

The summation of these nerfs/buffs is that the Airspeeders should feel faster when hitting airstreams, be more nimble on sharp turns, and generally the game should feel faster visually.

[h2]BEHIND THE SCENES[/h2]

[list]
[*] We have now completed our full transition to the very latest version of Unreal Engine 5.4.3. Ultimately this will allow the artists to fully utilize the very latest techniques and tools in order to make CELEROS look truly next-gen.
[*] We have now started integrating with deeper Steam features, starting with Friends. This will ultimately allow us to deploy new features such as Friend-based Leaderboards, notifications of times beaten, the ability to party up, and ultimately to be able to form a team and play together against other teams.
[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]
[list]
[*] The cockpit glass of the Airspeeder has been hidden whilst we fix an issue with how it interacts with the visuals of Track 2. It will return!
[*] Your position on Leaderboards will not be shown in the top-right hand corner of the screen. This will return next month!
[/list]

notes.title: Celeros at Steam Next Fest Update #1
notes.notes:
Attention pilots!

We’ve heard your feedback and acted in record time, releasing a [b]brand new update[/b] to make it even easier to enjoy playing [b]Celeros[/b] this week during [b]Steam Next Fest[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946915/5d7131aedd8092341530884f315b1d32acb3bb79.png[/img]

Check out the changes below:

[h3]Take to the Skies Faster!
[/h3]
A more seamless onboarding process has been implemented, allowing you to jump into your speeder without having to log in first!

[h3]Claim your official Alpine Esports Speeder Livery, only during Steam Next Fest
[/h3]
It’s now possible to claim this limited-edition decal in-game. Follow the prompts after loading up [b]Celeros [/b]to secure yours before it's gone forever!

Unlock the livery today for use after the full release of [b]Celeros[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44946915/48a198c3258f318fe1d3091b8cc7a151f9ddf9c9.png[/img]

[h3]Can you beat THOMB’s best time?[/h3]

Yesterday, [b]Alpine Esports Ambassador THOMB[/b] streamed [b]Celeros[/b] live at [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] and put down a standard-setting time of [b]54.80 seconds[/b]!
